g.text: NEGOTIATION LEVERS · PROPOSALS AFTER SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS
Both proposals preserve an 8% preferred return. Package A removes catch-up while keeping 20% carry.
Package B retains catch-up and reduces carry to 15%.
Common terms: the offered 1.35% fee; return of LP contributed capital (including contributions used for fees) before carry;
an 8% annual preferred return compounded on unreturned capital and unpaid preferred return. Preserve any stronger existing protection.

OPERF inception NPV; 20% asset growth; 15% discount rate. Baseline: 1.35% fee, 20% carry, no hurdle.
Package values depend on the scenario; actual amendments require forward valuation. The bars are alternatives, not cumulative demands.
